languageCoverage.notes: Pinned parser coverage; release gating follows tested editor and validation workflows.
Bundled standard library, custom roots, domain libraries, and optional Sysand dependency roots.
Daily editing workflows tracked in supported workflows.

semanticValidation.notes: Typed membership and namespace imports resolve with deterministic ambiguity and visibility handling. Filtered namespace imports are parser-recognized but intentionally unsupported. Namespace-member distinguishability uses published member identities and declared short names in supported categories; cross-category distinguishability awaits an owning typed fact. Private wildcard imports remain valid for internal use per SysML v2.
Typed variant usage kind is checked by the immutable semantic publication.

Expression, value and unit conformance is settled by the immutable publication: a unit token resolves to the unit declaration it names and carries that unit's measurement-reference type as its dimension, and a value's type is compared through the specialization closure rather than by spelling. invalid_enumeration_value is subsumed by attribute_value_type_mismatch, which reports any value whose type is unrelated to the feature's. The codes reach PublishedModel::diagnostics(), which every host now reports from.
Unit and metadata facts are owned by the immutable publication. Quantity library closure loads when workspace contains unit literals.

views.notes: Exposed scope as typed nodes; containment plus authored subsetting/subclassification/redefinition/typing edges (SysML 8.2.3.6).
Nested parts, ports on the node boundary, connection usages as edges (SysML 8.2.3.11); unresolved connector ends stay typed incomplete reasons.
Action and control nodes with ordered flow edges; unsupported control-node forms are explicit reasons.
State and control nodes; transition edges with typed trigger, guard, effect, and completeness.
Lifeline columns and message edges from authored sends and resolved ends; authoritative ordering only.
Collapsible ownership tree rooted at exposed scope.
Typed rows, columns, and cells from exposed elements and published relationships.
Provisional 2D primitives only for authoritative coordinates; otherwise exposed elements carry typed geometry incompleteness.
